     ---                                                                        
                                                                                
     ## What "Incompatible Trait" Means                                         
                                                                                
     The idea is to run GWAS on **Trait A**, then use the significant SNPs      
     from that GWAS to perform genomic selection on a **different trait         
     (Trait B)**. This tests cross-trait predictive ability -- whether SNPs     
     associated with one trait can predict another. High prediction             
     accuracy would suggest shared genetic architecture (pleiotropy)            
     between the two traits.                                                    
                                                                                
     ## Standard Workflow                                                       
                                                                                
     ```                                                                        
     Genotype data                                                              
         |                                                                      
         v                                                                      
     genotype-qc          -->  Cleaned PLINK binary (.bed/.bim/.fam)            
         |                                                                      
         v                                                                      
     plink-gwas           -->  GWAS on Trait A (e.g., growth rate)              
         |                                                                      
         v                                                                      
     plink_extract_by_p   -->  Extract SNPs with P < threshold from GWAS        
     results                                                                    
         |                                                                      
         v                                                                      
     makerawfile          -->  Convert filtered PLINK to .raw format            
         |                                                                      
         v                                                                      
     GS6models.R          -->  Run 6-model genomic selection CV on Trait B      
     (e.g., feed efficiency)                                                    
                               Compare BayesA/B/C, BRR, BL, GBLUP               
     performance                                                                
     ```                                                                        
                                                                                
     ## Available Data Found
